dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: No matter how far up you may climb, you still can't touch the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Hello. Hardly anyone comes around here. Are you here to stargaze?

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: The untouchable sky conceals the truth about the world... At least, that's what we Rtawahists believe.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: But the mortal sight is limited. Who can guarantee that they can see all the celestial signs clearly?

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: How about you, what do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me give it more thought...

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The stars determine your destiny...

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Ah, are you talking about the research on constellations?

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I don't have a Vision, so I couldn't participate in those research projects.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: But I feel the stars don't "decide" your destiny so much as they "show" it.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Because if it was decided, then it could be changed, right?

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: If destiny could be changed, maybe Greater Lord Rukkhadevata wouldn't have met her end.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The stars determine your destiny...

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Ah, are you talking about the research into constellations?

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I don't have a Vision, so I couldn't participate in those research projects.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: But I feel that the stars don't "decide" your destiny so much as they "show" it.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Because if such things can be "decided," then they can also be "changed," right?

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: If destiny could be rewritten just like that, I doubt that the Dendro Archon would have had to expend so much energy quelling the ancient calamity back then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Things might not be as they seem...

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: You're right. People can be easily distracted or deceived.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: If I were a matra, I might tell you that ignorance is also a blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: But people's ignorance will not affect the existence of truth. Sometimes blindness...

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Oh, I may have said too much. Just ignore my words and let it go with the wind.
